fixture_linear_solver.tridag_behavior: For every row the test stub assigns solution(i)=0 and ierror=0.
fixture_linear_solver.consequence: HeadCalc receives a zero Newton correction. A nonzero equilibrium residual therefore cannot be reduced by Newton iterations in this fixture.

fpe_linkage.implication: The F-PE03 binary low-cost/full-retry cliff was measured with the same zero-correction TRIDAG test double and cannot by itself characterize production Richards tail cost.

scale_check.interpretation: Observed transition is quantitatively consistent with the balance tolerance divided by equilibrium conductivity.

reference_source_check.behavior: The reference routine performs tridiagonal decomposition, forward substitution and back substitution; it does not return a zero correction except where the solved system implies one.
